base: black-and-white editorial fine-art photograph, desaturated, high contrast, fine film grain. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Extremely minimal composition with vast empty space. Dense haze; the ENTIRE UPPER HALF of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing. Subject small and dark, low in the frame. No text, no words, no logos, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look, no clutter.

images.scene: Early morning in front of a simple Brazilian house, camera very low at sidewalk level, shooting along the sidewalk. An old man with a hat sits alone on a wooden stool beside his open door, seen in full PROFILE from the side, small in the lower part of the frame, holding an enamel mug of coffee with both hands, still, looking out at the empty street. The house behind him is only a LOW plastered wall and the door frame, cut off well below the middle of the picture: NO roof, NO eaves, nothing above the wall but pale empty haze. Street and wall dissolve into haze. Soft low light.
